user_approved_scope: Evidence-based diagnosis, bounded entry/exit/risk/cost ablations, wallet-free diagnostic paper interface and scoped Issue6 utilities. This is not financial authorization or a requirement to manufacture positive performance.

baseline_diagnosis_before_ablation.source: Hash-matched cached fresh-window ledgers; no new fitting. ETH18month fast68trades/12wins, payoff7.34237, PF1.57337 at mid costs; slow20trades/3wins, payoff14.41150, PF2.54321. At stress slow net6.62926 of which largest winner6.39256. Slow six-month sample has9losses/0wins and gross loss before fees. These observations motivate entry and exit attribution, not an assumption that2R or3R improves results.
baseline_diagnosis_before_ablation.mfe_mae_scope: Ex-post high/low over entry bar through bar before next-open exit, plus actual entry/exit prices; no inferred intrabar execution.

implementation_plan: Read continuity, current code, actual Issue6 and cached-data/ledger hashes. Record baseline metrics and ex-post excursions before selecting new rules.
Write RED tests for a shared deterministic policy, completed-day filter, fixed initialR, one-way trailing stop, risk sizing, accounting/attribution, no-lookahead and strict paper-state recovery.
Add an isolated policy plus backtesting.py adapter, preserving the old engine. Require both new baseline trade ledgers/final accounts to match the unchanged old engine before using ablation results.

Execute the frozen candidate/cost/window grid; record every result/skip, exit reasons, MFE/MAE, R, costs and return concentration. Freeze the development-selected candidate before reading later-window results.
Add offline fee/Retry-After/duplicate-evidence helpers addressing Issue6 without changing old journals. Explicit chain/fork context required; no live cost qualification from synthetic tests.

Build a SQLite-backed, source/config-bound paper-step interface using the same decision policy. Historical warmup creates no trades; pending intents can fill only from a later timely observation. Test restart, duplicates, conflicts, stale input, missing bars and preserved exposure. No daemon or live wallet.
Publish paired FA/EN diagnosis, complete small result tables, reusable code/tests, evidence hashes and explicit uncompleted gates. Verify actual published bytes, rerun and CI; draft PR only.

fixed_mechanics.atr: 14-bar simple mean True Range; finite lookback, no recursive initialization ambiguity
fixed_mechanics.trend: Last fully completed UTC daily close above30-day SMA, SMA above its5-day-prior value. Completed day means all six source4h bars. No partial day. Last-known completed day is used at each bar close.
fixed_mechanics.warmup: Per-candidate required warmup; at least1284hbars and at least216for daily trend. Missing warmup rejects a window, not silently shorten the indicator.
fixed_mechanics.atr_initial_distance: min(3*ATR_at_entry_signal,5%of reference entry price); no widening beyond legacy5% in the exit experiment
fixed_mechanics.trailing: Check prior stop at completed close, then tighten only using highest completed close minus3*currentATR; no intrabar stop fills
fixed_mechanics.R0: At actual simulated entry: quantity*initial_stop_distance + entry_cost + modeled_exit_cost_at_initial_stop. Immutable thereafter. TP2R/3R solves for net mark-to-market gain using initialR and declared exit commission; final fill remains next observed price.
fixed_mechanics.sizing: Existing20%equity target,25notional cap,10reserve,5minimum preserved. Risk arm also caps planned stop+fees+0.1%notional uncertainty allowance at0.5%equity. Scaled-cap diagnostic changes only25constant to25%equity; not extra external capital.
fixed_mechanics.cost_gate: Reject when2ATR/price is less than3times estimated relative round-trip cost at proposed size. Volatility-to-cost screen ONLY, not an expected-profit estimate.
fixed_mechanics.risk: Legacy3%daily and10%drawdown observed-bar exits; max2entry intents/day; exits unrestricted; no leverage, martingale or top-ups.

markets.role: Transfer control; migration and bridge risks unresolved

windows.role: Chronological later diagnostic; globally seen in earlier research, NOT pristine holdout
One continuous compounded account; overlaps first two periods
Previously seen October window; cannot be reused as new untouched holdout

selection: Select at most one nonbaseline candidate using ETH development12m ONLY, maximizing worst(mid,stress) netProfit minus0.5*maxCloseDrawdown, requiring at least5closed trades in each cost and a strictly better score than slow baseline. Freeze selection record before processing other windows. If no improvement, retain slow baseline as RESEARCH_ONLY. All candidate later results still disclosed, never used to change winner.
acceptance: RESEARCH_ONLY unless development improvement survives positive net results at both costs in later6m and61d with sufficient trades, unchanged risk and no source/accounting faults. Any diagnostic paper label is research authorization only, never funded approval. Existing90day/100trade planning gates remain untouched; no forced trades.
scope_limits: No unobserved data currently available for an independent final claim. No future probabilities from bootstrap or dependent grid counts. No requested24month result without complete history. New ATR/targets are observed-close signals, not native DEX limit/stop orders. Infrastructure/tax/issuer parity and all-in real execution costs unresolved.
